usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Pushcut sends a notification to your device through “Send Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Notification” in Pushcut
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order reaches your device as a smart notification once Shopify reports it.

watchOut: Pushcut is an iOS app, so “Send Notification” reaches an iPhone or iPad rather than a desktop.
